title: Decay in renal impairment
question: Does the model predict the decay in renal impairment?

quantities.description: the concentration in renal impairment over the healthy one

factors.name: Software quality assurance
factors.statement: pkpdsim and sbmlsim are released packages with tests and continuous integration; the model is released reproducibly from its repository with the versions and the commit of the provenance.

factors.name: Numerical code verification
factors.statement: sbmlsim runs the SBML Test Suite and the PEtab test suite.

factors.name: Discretization error
factors.statement: The convergence of the results in the tolerances of the integrator.

factors.name: Numerical solver error
factors.statement: The results with a second integration method of the integrator.

factors.name: Use error
factors.statement: The validity and the units of the builds and the finite predictions of the evidence.

factors.name: Model form
factors.statement: The structure of the model across studies and drugs: the ratios, the cross-validation and the qualification across models.

factors.name: Model inputs
factors.statement: The uncertainty and the sensitivity of the parameters.

factors.name: Test samples
factors.statement: 10 points of 2 mappings of 1 study of the validation evidence decide, 10 of them evaluable (minimum 5).

factors.name: Test conditions
factors.statement: 2 claimed values of the metadata, 0 values of the evidence outside the claim.

factors.name: Equivalency of input parameters
factors.statement: Whether the inputs of the simulations of the evidence are the ones of the context of use: the individuals and their variability.

factors.name: Output comparison
factors.statement: 4 of 4 acceptance rules met on the validation evidence, 0 not evaluable.

factors.name: Relevance of the quantities of interest
factors.statement: 1 of 1 ratio pair within the limits of Guest et al. (>= 80 %), 1 of 1 ratio quantity covered.

factors.name: Relevance of the validation activities to the COU
factors.statement: 2 of 2 claimed values and 1 of 1 quantity of interest covered.
